description: Configure ESLint and Prettier to work together in the workspace at /home/ga/workspace/webapp. The project has conflicting formatter rules: ESLint enforces semicolons and 80-char lines, while Prettier disables semicolons and uses 100-char lines. Install the package 'eslint-config-prettier' using npm (npm install --save-dev eslint-config-prettier) to disable conflicting ESLint rules. Then, edit the .eslintrc.json file to add 'prettier' to the extends array (it must be the last item in the array to properly override formatting rules). Save both files when done. The workspace already has package.json, .eslintrc.json, and .prettierrc.json files with the initial conflicting configurations.
